newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian net foreign reserves $8.096 bln Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: Colombian net foreign reserves $8.096 bln Sept 27.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $8.096 billion as of September 27, the latest period for which official central bank figures are available, up slightly from $8.067 billion the previous week.
The total is the highest since March 2, when net reserves reached $8.01 billion, but was down from September 29 of last year, when net foreign reserves were $8.32 billion.
Net foreign reserves have dropped $228.4 million since the start of the year, the equivalent of 2.7 percent.
The central bank said the increase in the latest reserve figures stemmed from a $338.6 million drop in its short-term loan obligations abroad.
